questions.q: What is the core idea of Present Moment Functioning (PMF)?
a: Focus entirely on the current task
questions.why: PMF emphasizes staying in the present for high performance.

questions.q: According to Sterner, what should you do with long‑term goals during a work session?
a: Write them on a sticky note
questions.why: He advises to set them aside mentally while working.

questions.q: What three‑step technique helps regain focus when distracted?
questions.why: He outlines the Do, Observe, Correct method.

questions.q: Why does Sterner caution against using big goals as progress markers?
a: They can distort perception of daily improvement
They are too easy to achieve
questions.why: Large goals may mislead about real progress.

questions.q: What background gave Sterner insight into performance techniques?
a: 25 years as chief concert piano technician
questions.why: His piano tech career informed his approach.
